thread:
mira: Opened a small PR to update the hummingbird13b model card: clarify supported sequence ranges, add p50/p95 bench blurb, document int8 fallback behavior, and include a short CLI pin example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1127
devon: Nice. Is the bench link new or just the anchor?
mira: Anchor changed on the bench page so old link 404ed. I pointed card at /bench#hummingbird13b and added p50=120ms, p95=310ms (internal link included).
lee: Runtime flagged cold-start increase for int8 fallback (~1.25x). Can you add a one-line note under "compatibility"?
mira: Done: "int8 variants may increase cold-start latency by ~1.25x due to kernel init." Also added model YAML snippet so Console can surface fallback: variants:
  - name: hummingbird13b-fp32
  - name: hummingbird13b-int8
    fallback: true
devon: Could we add a tiny CLI example showing pinning the variant? Sales often paste that.
mira: Added CLI snippet in migration note: `rw model serve --model hummingbird13b-fp32` with a short sentence: "Pin a variant to avoid runtime fallback variance."
docs-ci-bot: check failed - anchor /bench#hummingbird13b missing on target page.
lee: Pushing a small bench page heading fix now to add the anchor. I'll avoid changing the TOC.
docs-ci-bot: all checks green on PR 1127 (linkcheck, lint, spell).
support: Filing an internal support note summarizing fallback behavior and bench numbers: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/hummingbird13b-fallback
mira: Merging once CI is green. Thanks all! :tada:
devon: :thumbsup:
lee: LGTM and approved.
